title: Implement draft-atwood-jmap-graph-provenance-00 (urn:ietf:params:jmap:graph:provenance)
description: Spec: /data/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec/draft-atwood-jmap-graph-provenance-00.md (addb3fb). From audit JMAP-t8ej.6: no crate implements it. Required work under Mark's 2026-11-12 rule (crate-jmap is the complete reference implementation). Layout: a provenance module in jmap-graph-types and jmap-graph-server, opt-in like graph-edit/search; client bindings in jmap-graph-client. Adds GraphNode provenance (basis, confidence, validUntil, validFor PermittedUse, credentialDigest) and curation (status, pinned, curationReason) properties, the evidence edge type (max 32 per record), GraphRights.mayCurate, Graph.retention with a server retention sweep, irreversible retraction, and four GraphNode/query filters (basis, status, pinned, validAt). No new methods.
